per_round:
Refactored test setup for speed and reuse: introduced invoice/customer/organization/payment-method factories and fixtures, batch-created customers, added a transactional `db_session`, centralized time with a frozen clock, and removed repeated organization/model setup. Full suite passes in about 15 seconds (318 passed, 4 skipped), down by roughly 25 seconds. An invoice covering index was rejected because it doubled ingest write latency. Established that fields ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` must only be copied through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.

The stated goal of adding pagination to `GET /v1/invoices` in `ledgerly/api/invoices.py` has not yet been implemented.

A production Vault/Kubernetes credential-rotation procedure was explicitly requested, but the log contains no evidence that any of its ordered operational steps were executed; do not assume rotation, restart, verification, lease revocation, or cleanup occurred.

Latest relevant result: `tests/integration/test_invoice_sync.py` intermittently fails with an expected HTTP 202 but receives 409 (7 passed, 1 failed); this remains unresolved.

Refactored shared test setup for speed and reuse using factories, fixtures, batched customer creation, a transactional session, and frozen time. The full suite previously passed 318 tests with 4 skips, and a later repository run passed 126 tests with 3 skips. A rejected invoice-index experiment doubled ingest latency, so it was not retained. Sensitive fields ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` must only be copied through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.

Fixed an intermittent invoice-sync idempotency race: duplicate concurrent requests could see a stale `processing` record and return 409. Completion updates are now guarded by invoice ID, completed responses are replayed, fixture cleanup includes the payment stub, and a concurrent regression test was added. Integration tests, unit tests, Ruff checks, and a 200-request stress test passed. Committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race`.

Work resumed on `GET /v1/invoices` pagination. The route currently accepts only the database session and returns all invoices; `InvoiceService.list_invoices` executes an unbounded descending query. Existing `InvoiceResponse` schemas and API tests were located for implementing pagination next. No production Vault/Kubernetes credential-rotation steps have been performed.

Implemented invoice-list pagination with a new `InvoicePage` schema. `GET /v1/invoices` now validates `limit` (1–100, default 20) and `offset`, returns an envelope containing `items`, `total`, `limit`, and `offset`, and uses a bounded service query. Existing invoice API tests, three new pagination tests, Ruff, diff checks, and the broader 18-test billing suite all pass.

Investigation then shifted to slow invoice-summary reporting. Its nested tenant/currency loops repeatedly query invoices; profiling showed 2,417 SQL statements for a medium-tenant test and about 39 seconds dominated by `build_summary`. The next step is optimizing this N+1 pattern. Keep commits small. Staging must use `db-stg-2.internal`; `config/staging.yaml` is stale. Never modify `ledgerly/migrations/` without first contacting @dana-db in `#prod-db-changes`. Sensitive fields remain restricted to `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.

Implemented and optimized invoice-summary reporting: consolidated per-currency invoice queries into one aggregate query, added batched minor-unit conversion, and introduced a stable 37-query regression assertion. The medium-tenant workload dropped from 2,417 queries/39 seconds to 37 queries/4.27 seconds, with unchanged aggregates. All 18 summary tests, Ruff, 63 report tests, and 2,432 profiling checks passed; two PostgreSQL-dependent tests skipped.

Also fixed invoice PDF rendering so negative credit lines are retained and appear immediately after their related item, replacing the positive-only filter with a zero-only exclusion. Added a regression test; the focused test and full PDF suite pass (12 passed, 1 skipped). Reviewed `render_invoice()` and identified seven call sites plus fixtures. Vault was verified initialized and unsealed. Continue with small commits; use `db-stg-2.internal` rather than stale config. Do not modify `ledgerly/migrations/` without contacting @dana-db in `#prod-db-changes`; sensitive fields remain restricted to `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.

Continued invoice PDF and SQLAlchemy cleanup. Replaced duplicated invoice amount formatting with locale-aware `format_money()` and added exact-output coverage for positive, negative, and zero values. Fixed page-height calculations using points-to-inches conversion, centralized continuation-header reservation, and added an 86-item pagination regression; PDF tests pass (14 passed, 1 skipped), billing tests pass (83 passed, 4 skipped), and existing golden PDFs remain byte-stable. Next, visually inspect the three generated PDFs.

SQLAlchemy modernization removed the invalid `echo=True` engine option, migrated models to `DeclarativeBase`, and replaced deprecated invoice `Query.get()` calls with `session.get()`. Full baseline is 148 passed, 2 skipped; invoice repository tests pass (19 passed) without the legacy warning.
